edit.description: bound `reason` to a single line so the SHIPPED.md writer and `readShippedTags` cannot disagree
drive the refusal through the factory's declared entryExtension

summary: Bound the groomer's `reason` to one line: an embedded newline forges a SHIPPED.md tag and silently unblocks a blockedBy item
acceptance: A `reason` carrying a newline is refused at parse; no BACKLOG.json the groomer accepts can write a SHIPPED.md line `readShippedTags` reads as a second tag.
tests: the backlog groomer's entry extension refuses a multi-line reason
notes: examples/backlog-groomer-chain.ts:65 bounds `reason` by length alone; :157 interpolates it into `- <tag>: <reason>\n`; :94 reads that file back with /^- ([a-z0-9-]+):/ and feeds the set to isPickableNow as shippedTags. A newline shaped like a ledger line is read as a shipped tag nothing shipped.
